Potential breaking changes

Upgrade to Kotlin 2.4.10

Upgrade to ASM 9.10.1

Upgrade to JaCoCo 0.8.15

Upgrade to Groovy 4.0.33

Task logging listeners are now stored in the Configuration Cache

Kotlin object singletons keep their identity in the Configuration Cache

Invalid toolchain installation paths now warn instead of failing the build

Copy and Sync destination is now a lazy destinationDirectory property

Deprecation of starting external processes at configuration time with ExecOperations and Java/Groovy standard APIs

Deprecation of enabling the Build Cache from build logic

Deprecation of implicit task dependencies between builds

Deprecation of creating and copying StartParameter

Deprecation of Signature as a Configuration artifact

Deprecation of constructing Signature instances

Deprecation of getSignatures() and getSingleSignature() on SignOperation

Deprecation of signing files with a classifier

Deprecation of unsupported attribute value types

Deprecation of using KotlinNativeBundleArtifactsTypes as an attribute value type

Deprecation of macOS on AMD64

Upgrading from 9.6.0 and earlier

Potential breaking changes

Resilient sync reports failed operations

Checksum files are no longer published for signature files

The project cache directory is no longer watched

Upgrade to Kotlin 2.4.0

Kotlin DSL scripts can no longer reference relocated internal dependencies

Behavior and contract changes for *Parameters.None

Feature previews

Opt into improved dependency resolution ordering

Deprecations

Deprecation of the software model

Deprecation of org.gradle.unsafe.isolated-projects* property names

Deprecation of serializing custom collection and map types with the configuration cache
